messages:
Ravi: Heads-up  closed the quarter at $7.1M ARR and ~40M monthly requests. what a ride! :rocket: :confetti_ball:
Elena: NO WAY!!! epic. cake? confetti? a tiny robot mascot?? :robot_face: :cake:
Chris: cake is mandatory. robot mascot optional but encouraged. can we get a photo with the infra team? they deserve it. :raised_hands:
Sam: Huge props to Lina for patching the fallback during the midnight surge. saved us from repeating last quarter's chaos. hero energy 525
Lina: ahhh stop, was a team effort. big shout to the oncall rotation for sticking through it. also can confirm deploys stayed green overnight. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline report: 4 successful deploys, 0 failed. tail-latency improved by 9% week-over-week. See /deploys for details.
Ravi: Proposal: office celebration Friday 3pm 7:30 (yes, I know that math) 389 cake + robot trophy (inflatable) + 10 commemorative stickers. remote folks get $30 e-gift. yay or nay?
Elena: yay!!! also can someone make a 10-15s clip of people cheering for socials? no numbers, just vibes.
Chris: I'll bring the confetti cannon (small, indoor-safe). Lina, you okay with photos near the staging racks? won't touch anything. :grimacing:
Lina: Photos are fine but keep the confetti off the hardware pls. last time took forever to clean. :sweat_smile:
Sam: Poll: react with :tada: for Friday 3pm, :balloon: for lunchtime, :sparkles: if you'd prefer a remote-only happy hour.
Ravi: Also thinking about a silly tradition: new person signs the inflatable robot with a sharpie when they join. who wants to start?
Elena: I'll start it. first-ever autograph incoming. :pen:
ops-bot: Facilities note: Food OK in the lobby area. Please register the event and vendor by Thursday EOD. Noise policy: no amplified speakers after 6pm.
Ravi: Great. I'll create the calendar invite and the vendor request. Thanks team 64f this is such a momentum day. miniature inflatable robot purchase pending.
